_howto: Yahi aapki library ki list hai. Jo book/comic SABKO dikhani hai, uska entry niche 'books' list me add karo, aur uski file repo me (root me) upload karo. Ek entry ke baad comma (,) lagana mat bhoolna. Save karke Commit kar do — sab log turant dekh payenge.
